_comment: Class prior for buildings. Every value here used to be a constant inside a 'generic' script (WORKFLOW-V3 §2). Data only: anything that is a FUNCTION (layout measures, V7 building rows, V11 buildability rows) lives in `rules`. Priors select rules; they never fabricate observations.
roleHint: pick the nearest real one (a stair board is "step", a handrail is "railing", a window surround is "window")
_knobPriors_comment: WORKFLOW v4 V4-5B: ranges for the KNOBS a verified layout key does not bound (scripts/knobs.mjs priorKnob: {span, of: W|H|m} = v +/- span x size, or {min, max}, or {locked}). W / H / D are the registration anchor (template-building pickFrame + massing.depthOverW), never fitted. _unverifiedKey: a knob whose key is unverified or missing and has no entry here.

W._why: V5-1 item 2: the facade ASPECT is fitted (supersedes the fixed-metric-size ruling); absolute scale is the fitted similarity frameScale

H._why: V5-1 item 2: free relative to the storey pitch; absolute scale is frameScale

D._why: V5-1 item 2: the side return is fitted (massing.depthOverW is the gate band)

_residualFloor_comment: scripts/loop.mjs target stop: a shown residual row under both is noise (MVP-STUB: the vehicle's numbers, not measured on a building).
_censusRules_comment: census key -> how it is counted off ROLES (V12_CENSUS). kind assembly = union-find over overlapping ranges on `axes` (+ `pad` m); kind band = y/x-centre bands no wider than censusRowBand. `sums` = the census keys whose SUM this rule checks (vent + pipes share role roof_fixture).
_roleIdColours_comment: Role -> flat id colour for the ID PASS (?capture=1&idpass=1). CLOSED: one entry per role above; partsToGeometry throws on a role with no entry. Widely separated so an 8-bit sRGB round-trip cannot confuse two.

likeness._comment: scripts/likeness.mjs. areaFamilies: the commensurable LK_AREA families (zone names in regions.json). droppedAreaZones: zones that absorb pixels but carry no row. censusInstances: role -> census key, or a list of keys whose SUM is the instance count (LK_VISIBLE). ironRoles: roles that must never cover a window opening (audit L5). overlapRoles: the roles LK_OVERLAP actually counts inside window rects (run3 P2: landings do cross the window column, only the roof ladder must stay clear). thinRoles: members that fragment behind treads, judged by pooled px.
likeness._thin_comment: V5-7 item 1 (scripts/accuracy.mjs thinMeasure / judgeThin): an item whose visible render px are a stroke (95th-percentile inner distance <= widthPx / 2) is judged on its CENTRELINE (mean render-skeleton <-> target-stroke distance <= max(centrePx, min(floorCapPx, its render-as-target floor)); stroke = ink (luminance < inkLum) or its family's px), and a repeated one (a profileRoles role, >= minParts straight parallel members, PCA resultant >= parallel) on COUNT + PITCH (|d| <= max(pitchPx, pitchFrac x pitch)) from an ink / render projection profile (peaks >= peak). Region metrics cannot see 1-4 px frames and ironwork (the target draws them as ink).
likeness._inkOpen_comment: V5-5 item 2 (scripts/accuracy.mjs targetOf): per family, target px that do not survive an opening of this radius (px) are ink strokes / AA slivers — don't care, never target.

_paletteZones_comment: scripts/calibrate-palette.mjs. key = the palette key an authored module uses; region = the zone name in regions.json (a region regions.json does not carry is sampled at point/radius); point/radius = the fallback sample on the target, with the colour it reads there; for = what the key paints, printed in the prompt. WF-BLIND-R2 C4/C10: the list is CLOSED and has ONE author key per material — a part in any other zone fails PALETTE_ZONE. The aliases trim / parapet / metal were deleted (blind Terra painted all ironwork `metal`, which calibrated to the AC grey). `closure: true` entries exist only so every likeness-family zone has a calibration; they are not author keys (`material` names the author key that paints it).
